levels.surface: أبي عبد الله جعفر بن محمد

notes: The report opens with a bare «وعن» plus a name. The previous report's chain (prev1, «محمد بن يعقوب ... عبد العزيز بن مسلم») does not contain Muhammad b. Yahya, so no name is taken over; the chain is read as written.
The Imam sits inside the chain after «عن» (narrator, owner ruling 2); his sermon («إن الله تعالى أوضح ...») is the saying.
